title: Shooting Stars Explained by Science
description:
When you see a bright streak of light in the night sky, is it a meteor or a meteorite? People often confuse the two, but science makes a clear distinction.

This video explains:

What meteors are — space rocks or dust burning up as they enter Earth’s atmosphere.
What meteorites are — fragments that survive the fiery journey and land on Earth.
Why we call them shooting stars even though they’re not stars at all.
How meteoroids, meteors, and meteorites are connected.
The role of friction and heat in creating glowing trails.
The importance of meteorites in understanding the early solar system.

We also explore famous falls like the Chelyabinsk meteor in Russia (2013), and why collecting meteorites is like holding the building blocks of planets in your hands.

If you’ve searched for “meteor vs meteorite explained,” “what is a shooting star,” “Chelyabinsk meteor,” “meteoroid meteor meteorite difference,” “meteorite science,” or “space rocks hitting Earth”, this video makes it simple and clear.
